concept: A website chatbot's answers as a fortune cookie, rendered in 3D (Blender). One golden cookie standing on a sage table and the slip that came out of it: Yes, we're open on Sundays. Right up against the slip: sounds sure, but you're shut on Sundays. Nearer and higher, the same cookie with a new slip: I'll check with the team. Sounds honest. Sage, baked gold, paper white and one ultramarine ink.
